Class ScopedKeyValues

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.ScopedKeyValues
public final class ScopedKeyValues extends Object
Request/task-scoped key values, pushed once (typically once, wrapping an entire request or task at its boundary) and never mutated afterward.

This is deliberately not a replacement for ad-hoc, imperative, single-call-site key values (e.g. SLF4J's own LoggingEventBuilder#addKeyValue(String, Object)) - that is still the right tool for "add this to just this one log line". This class is for the opposite shape: a small number of values that should be visible on every log line for an entire request/task, set up once, at a well-known boundary.

The actual push/read mechanism is supplied by whichever ScopedKeyValuesProvider is found via ServiceLoader the first time this class is used - the same bootstrap shape SLF4J itself uses for org.slf4j.spi.SLF4JServiceProvider. If none is found, pushing still runs the body normally, it just does not record or propagate anything - always safe to depend on this module alone, even with nothing bound.

    ScopedKeyValues.Builder
    Builds one immutable layer of key values and pushes it for the duration of a ScopedKeyValues.Builder.run(Runnable)/ScopedKeyValues.Builder.call(CallableOp) call.
    static interface 
    ScopedKeyValues.CallableOp<R, X extends Throwable>
    Like java.lang.ScopedValue.CallableOp but declared here so this API module never has to reference java.lang.ScopedValue itself, keeping it compilable on older JDKs - the real ScopedValue-backed provider (a separate module requiring a newer JDK) bridges the two with a plain method reference, since both interfaces share the same R call() throws X shape.
